views.markdown: Hide the status-bar Back to App breadcrumb on iOS 18.

views.title: Rootless
views.text: iphoneos-arm64 · expected on iOS 18+ rootless jailbreaks

views.markdown:
### What it does

- Hides the Back to App breadcrumb in the SpringBoard status bar.
- Leaves time, carrier, signal, Wi-Fi, battery, and other indicators unchanged.
- Removes the breadcrumb before it is created, so there is no leftover gap.
- Applies immediately after respring.
- No preference pane or configuration.

### How it works

iOS 18 creates the breadcrumb through `SBDeviceApplicationSceneStatusBarBreadcrumbProvider`. Hide Breadcrumbs hooks the provider's decision method and returns `NO`. That is the same decision the system makes when its native `SBNeverBreadcrumb` preference is enabled: the breadcrumb action context is never created, so the status-bar item never appears.

### Install

1. Download the matching deb: RootHide (`iphoneos-arm64e`) or Rootless (`iphoneos-arm64`).
2. Install with Sileo, Zebra, or Filza.
3. Respring.

### Verification

SHA-256 checksums are published in `SHA256SUMS.txt` with the GitHub release. Verify the downloaded deb before installing it.

### Compatibility

Tested on iOS 18.4.1 (Dopamine 3, RootHide). The rootless build is expected to work on iOS 18+ rootless jailbreaks. The tweak requires iOS 18.0 or later.

### 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Hides the Back to App breadcrumb in the SpringBoard status bar.
- Leaves other status-bar indicators unchanged.
- Rootless and RootHide packages.
